title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Blueberry Raspberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Raspberry from the JNP Bar Salts collection provides a perfectly balanced, everyday fruit profile. The smooth, earthy sweetness of dark Blueberry creates a rich and satisfying base, which is brightened immediately by a tart, vibrant layer of fresh Raspberry. This contrasting berry combination delivers a consistently vivid and uplifting taste from start to finish. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the rich berry notes of Blueberry Raspberry, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the sweet Blue Razz Gummy Bear or the crisp Double Apple Shisha.
